name: Fredrik
source:
LIKES: Anime 
DISLIKES: Being alone

Fredrik fancies himself as a funny guy and always tries to make others laugh. Sometimes his timing is off and he tries to make light of the wrong situation.

He's accompanied by his best pal, Chippins - a charming little fox with attitude.

Fredrik came to Japan after leaving his home city of Stockholm, Sweden. He claims that he's trying to learn Japanese due to his interest in anime, manga and video games - but you think he really just wants to make some friends.

Though Fredrik doesn't speak much of his home life, you're confident he had a happy upbringing due to his upbeat and energetic nature. He has a soft spot for animals and speaks fondly of the pets he had growing up.

Shortly after your adventure starts, Fredrik meets a wild fox in the wilderness! What could have been a dangerous situation turns into a fateful encounter when the fox cuddles up to Fredrik and doesn't want to leave his side!

Fredrik is overwhelmed with happiness to make a new friend. He names the fox Chippins, and together, they vow to learn Japanese!
